```{r}

#############################################################################################################

# Genomic annotation analysis of strand-biased hPu-hPy repeat loci
# - Imports hPu and hPy repeat datasets associated with positive and negative replication fork orientation
# - Loads repeat coordinates from BED files and computes repeat lengths
# - Groups related repeat motifs into biologically relevant motif families
# - Classifies repeat loci according to replication fork directionality (Pos or Neg)
# - Annotates repeat regions relative to genes using ChIPseeker and GENCODE-derived gene models
# - Assigns repeats to genomic features including promoters, exons, introns, and intergenic regions
# - Simplifies genomic annotations into genic and intergenic categories
# - Quantifies the distribution of repeat families across genomic annotations
# - Compares genomic localization patterns between positively and negatively replicated repeat sets
# - Calculates annotation frequencies and proportions for each repeat-family group
# - Generates faceted stacked barplots displaying genomic feature enrichment
# - Separately visualizes genic and intergenic repeat distributions
# - Exports figure in PDF format
#
# Requirements:
#   - dplyr
#   - ggplot2
#   - scales
#   - stringr
#   - tidyr
#   - GenomicRanges
#   - IRanges
#   - ChIPseeker
#   - TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene
#   - org.Hs.eg.db

#############################################################################################################

# Install required packages
# Load libraries

# Packages installation (CRAN + Bioconductor)
cran_pkgs <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "scales",
  "stringr",
  "tidyr"
)

bioc_pkgs <- c(
  "GenomicRanges",
  "ChIPseeker",
  "TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene",
  "org.Hs.eg.db"
)

# Utility function: install only missing CRAN packages
install_missing_cran <- function(pkgs) {
  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    install.packages(
      missing,
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }
}

# Utility function: install only missing Bioconductor packages
install_missing_bioc <- function(pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(
      "BiocManager",
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }

  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    BiocManager::install(
      missing,
      ask = FALSE,
      update = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# Install missing packages
install_missing_cran(cran_pkgs)
install_missing_bioc(bioc_pkgs)

message("All required packages are installed.")

#############################################################################################################

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ChIPseeker)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# User inputs (paths to BED files)

bed_hPu_neg_path <- "/hPu/OKseq/neg/bed/file/path"
bed_hPy_neg_path <- "/hPy/OKseq/neg/bed/file/path"

bed_hPu_pos_path <- "/hPu/OKseq/pos/bed/file/path"
bed_hPy_pos_path <- "/hPy/OKseq/pos/bed/file/path"

txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene

# Read bed files
read_bed_strict <- function(path) {
  df <- read.table(path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(df) <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "motif")
  df
}

bed_hPu_neg <- read_bed_strict(bed_hPu_neg_path)
bed_hPy_neg <- read_bed_strict(bed_hPy_neg_path)
bed_hPu_pos <- read_bed_strict(bed_hPu_pos_path)
bed_hPy_pos <- read_bed_strict(bed_hPy_pos_path)

# Processing
process_bed <- function(df, sample_name){
  df$length_bp <- df$end - df$start
  df$sample <- sample_name
  df
}

bed_hPu_neg <- process_bed(bed_hPu_neg, "hPu Neg")
bed_hPy_neg <- process_bed(bed_hPy_neg, "hPy Neg")
bed_hPu_pos <- process_bed(bed_hPu_pos, "hPu Pos")
bed_hPy_pos <- process_bed(bed_hPy_pos, "hPy Pos")

bed_all <- rbind(
  bed_hPu_neg, bed_hPy_neg,
  bed_hPu_pos, bed_hPy_pos
)

# Grouping
bed_filtered <- bed_all %>%
  mutate(
    motif_clean = str_replace_all(motif, " ", ""),
    group = case_when(
      motif_clean %in% c("(GA)n","(AG)n") ~ "(GA)n",
      motif_clean %in% c("(GAA)n","(AAG)n","(AGA)n") ~ "(GAA)n",
      motif_clean %in% c("(GAAA)n","(AAAG)n","(AAGA)n","(AGAA)n") ~ "(GAAA)n",
      motif_clean %in% c("(GGAA)n","(GAAG)n","(AAGG)n","(AGGA)n",
                         "(GAAAA)n","(AAAAG)n","(AAAGA)n","(AAGAA)n","(AGAAA)n") ~ "(GAAAA)n",
      motif_clean %in% c("(TC)n","(CT)n") ~ "(TC)n",
      motif_clean %in% c("(TCT)n","(TTC)n","(CTT)n") ~ "(TTC)n",
      motif_clean %in% c("(TTTC)n","(CTTT)n","(TCTT)n","(TTCT)n") ~ "(TTTC)n",
      motif_clean %in% c("(TTCC)n","(CCTT)n","(TCCT)n","(CTTC)n",
                         "(CTTTT)n","(TTTTC)n","(TTTCT)n","(TTCTT)n","(TCTTT)n") ~ "(TTTTC)n",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    category = case_when(
      grepl("Pos$", sample) ~ "Pos",
      grepl("Neg$", sample) ~ "Neg"
    )
  )

# Annotation of repeat motifs to genomic regions
# Add a unique identifier to each repeat
bed_filtered$id <- 1:nrow(bed_filtered)

# Convert repeats to GRanges object
gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = bed_filtered$chrom,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = bed_filtered$start,
    end   = bed_filtered$end
  ),
  id = bed_filtered$id
)

# Annotate repeats relative to genes (hg19)
peakAnno <- annotatePeak(
  gr,
  TxDb = txdb,
  tssRegion = c(-1000, 1000),
  annoDb = "org.Hs.eg.db"
)

anno_df <- as.data.frame(peakAnno)

# Simplify genomic annotations into four categories
anno_df$annotation_simple <- case_when(
  grepl("Promoter", anno_df$annotation) ~ "Promoter",
  grepl("Exon", anno_df$annotation) ~ "Exon",
  grepl("Intron", anno_df$annotation) ~ "Intron",
  TRUE ~ "Intergenic"
)

# Merge annotation results with repeat information
bed_annot <- bed_filtered %>%
  inner_join(
    anno_df[, c("id", "annotation_simple")],
    by = "id"
  )

# Classify repeats as genic or intergenic
bed_annot <- bed_annot %>%
  mutate(
    region_type = ifelse(
      annotation_simple == "Intergenic",
      "Intergenic",
      "Genic"
    )
  )

# Prepare data for visualization
plot_df <- bed_annot %>%
  mutate(
    annotation_plot = case_when(
      region_type == "Intergenic" ~ "Intergenic",
      TRUE ~ annotation_simple
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    group,
    category,
    region_type,
    annotation_plot
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    group,
    category,
    region_type
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Keep only strand-biased repeat sets
plot_posneg <- plot_df %>%
  filter(category %in% c("Pos", "Neg"))

# Define annotation order
plot_posneg$annotation_plot <- factor(
  plot_posneg$annotation_plot,
  levels = c(
    "Promoter",
    "Exon",
    "Intron",
    "Intergenic"
  )
)

# Define panel order
plot_posneg$category <- factor(
  plot_posneg$category,
  levels = c("Pos", "Neg")
)

# Stacked barplot of genomic annotations
p <- ggplot(plot_posneg,aes(x = group,y = n,fill = annotation_plot)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",color = "black") +
  facet_grid(region_type ~ category) +
  labs(x = "",y = "Count of repeats",fill = "Genomic location") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Promoter" = "black","Exon" = "grey60","Intergenic" = "antiquewhite3")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,hjust = 1))

p

# Export figure
ggsave(
  "barplot_annotation_negpos.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)

#############################################################################################################

```
